The State of School Feeding Worldwide isWFP’s flagship publication issued everytwo years, providing a comprehensiveanalysis of global trends on school mealprogrammes.The State of School Feeding Worldwide 2024 presents a combination ofthe latest data, case studies, research and evidence on school mealprogrammes, highlighting key changes since the last publication. Itpoints to a shift in how countries perceive school meals, not only as theworld’s largest and most effective safety net during crises, but also as amajor contributor to national development to help address society-wideproblems.
